name: vault-hq
description: A local front end for an Obsidian-style markdown vault: what needs you, your days, tasks, notes you can read and edit, and Ask on local models.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.demo: node demo/make-demo.mjs && npm run build && VAULT_PATH=/Users/Shared/hq-demo/demo-vault VAULT_STATE=/Users/Shared/hq-demo/state TASK_BIN=/Users/Shared/hq-demo/task HQ_PORT=4330 HQ_CORE_ONLY=1 node server/index.ts
